claim_ceiling: Metadata and rights-readiness audit only. No raw data acquisition, baseline reproduction or utility field qualification has been performed.

datasets.title: Comprehensive DAS event-classification dataset
datasets.collection_profile: Campus DAS; HDF5 waveforms with JSON annotations and NumPy event-window masks; nine classes; 324465 reported event/window samples in 14 HDF5 files.
datasets.reported_volume: 47.1 GB on a community mirror; official Figshare record must be checked before retrieval.
known_caveats: class imbalance: regular/background 210023 of 324465 reported samples
suitable_tasks: exact published nine-class reproduction subject to permission
classification benchmark research after rights clearance
unsuitable_claims: commercial product training/evaluation without separate written permission
datasets.next_step: Obtain written commercial permission or exclude from company-controlled commercial research; audit Figshare official record.

datasets.title: Trondheim ship arrival and localization DAS corpus
datasets.collection_profile: Subsea fibre in Trondheimsfjord; acquired 2020-03-03; ship-noise/event-arrival DAS data.
suitable_tasks: persistent-homology baseline reproduction after rights clearance
datasets.next_step: Check licence and data owner/cable permissions before sample acquisition.

datasets.title: OOI RCA 2025-2026 OptoDAS data
datasets.collection_profile: South OOI RCA cable; HDF5; approximately 8 Hz; 2025-11-12 to 2026-01-28; temporal/spatial settings vary.
known_caveats: 40 m gauge length appears highest quality
datasets.next_step: Verify rights and acquire only a small read-range sample.

datasets.title: OOI RCA 2025-2026 Nokia multi-span DAS
datasets.publisher: Zenodo / University of Washington and Nokia Bell Labs
datasets.collection_profile: North and south OOI subsea cables; multi-span binary files with arrays and metadata; approximately 8 Hz; 10-200 m variable channel spacing.
known_caveats: authors report nonlinearities and cross-phase modulation
spatial masking applied; residual non-physical noise remains
absolute timestamps delayed by several seconds
unsuitable_claims: physical cable-event truth across all spans
claim that raw dataset is fully physically accurate
datasets.next_step: Verify rights and use only documented masked/sample subsets for initial parser tests.

global_controls: No bulk download until rights, use purpose, data readiness and storage budget are verified.
Public accessibility does not imply commercial-use or derivative-redistribution permission.
Every acquired byte stream receives a new SHA-256 digest and byte-length record.
Publisher metadata, Zenodo DOI, mirror MD5 and derived artifact digest are distinct evidence fields.
Site/day/session/event leakage is prohibited in generalization splits.
Marine, campus, laboratory, synthetic, operational utility and independently surveyed evidence remain separate populations.
Known calibration problems, outages, non-physical noise, masks and time delays are recorded rather than silently repaired.
Dataset accuracy scores remain linked to author task and split; no cross-task leaderboard.
